text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Ikuno Dictus and Bamboo 
Memory talking in the courtyard plaza.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So the flower bed was trampled and 
vandalized by an unknown party?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! So please, help me track 
down the culprit! Using my brain like this 
really ain't my strong suit!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case... first, let us 
ask around to see if anyone witnessed the 
perpetrator.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch! In that case, the first 
witness was—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa?! Great Detective Ikuno?! 
For starters, push up your glasses and—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hit 'em with the, 'The culprit is clearly 
in our midst!' or somethin' like that~♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall perform that once we 
locate the culprit, so please provide us 
with your testimony.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, like an interrogation sesh? Hold up! 
Lemme think of some fire dialogue real 
quick!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Embellishments are unnecessary. Please 
simply share concisely what you witnessed.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Roger roger~♪ Uhh, let's see, what did I 
see again...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I think I saw Gol-pippi. Wait, 
wild☆ Did I just crack the case wide open?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gol-pippi... Wait, Golshi again?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Again"...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I actually caught her once just a 
bit ago. Good grief, she never learns!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please wait. Acting on mere assumptions 
without concrete evidence would be 
premature.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But the only thing the culprit left behind 
were footprints, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Footprints...! That is splendid evidence 
that could lead to identifying the 
culprit. Please show me at once.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the depth and size of these 
prints, the culprit is not particularly 
large in build.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And above all... the horseshoe 
impressions.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As horseshoes are used over time, they 
come to reflect the unique characteristics 
of their wearer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa☆ Totally legit detective vibes! 
Wait, Ikuno, aren't you actually super 
into this?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hmmm? In short, what does that 
mean...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It means we can glean information 
regarding the culprit from the horseshoe 
impressions.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Given the severe wear on the front toe 
portion of the shoe, this belongs to 
someone whose forward drive and 
determination are extraordinarily strong.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then doesn't that mean it's not Golshi? 
Golshi isn't that kind of runner!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Helios-san. Did you truly see no one 
other than Golshi-san? Please recall 
carefully.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I found the footprints~. Then I 
called over Bamboo, who happened to be 
nearby—...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
............The culprit has been 
identified without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gh?! Ikuno, what are you doing—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way! It was me! I was the one trampling 
it...! I am so, so deeply sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, it was not intentional. And 
fortunately, the flowers were not harmed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, restoring this minor amount 
of damage will be simple. I shall assist 
you as well.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally! We'll wrap it up in seconds♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You two............!! ...Thank you so 
much!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, thanks to the astute deduction 
of Ikuno Dictus, the mystery was cleanly 
resolved.
